canon_observation_kind: Root manual CUA accessibility/inline screenshot transcription; no native screenshot archive or automated GUI replay.
restored_file_capture_kind: Read-only raw file capture after successful native GUI retry and normal QA quit; copied now, not a reconstructed pre-crash snapshot.
restore_crash_trace_limit: Failed crash helper has no retained stdout file. gui-crash.json contains the accurate root outcome/terminal verification, not a fabricated full trace.
readback_provenance_limit: Canon readback JSON omits historical interpreter version/executable and invocation exit code; exact installed module bytes/path are retained. No historical command receipt invented.
restored_readback_scope_note: Root actual GUI retry is observed separately; gui-restored-readback.json comes from the normal packaged verification-only helper. Its generic inherited CLI scope label does not change retry provenance.
